verdict: M243's hashes, N=7,318,350, single-stream arithmetic, fixed-compute Amdahl arithmetic and claim discipline independently check out. The wrong-SHA attack is rejected, and M243 does charge one five-cycle fill. The exact frozen-population application is nevertheless wrong: N is the per-inference sum of 45 distinct T10 operator contexts, not one uninterrupted context. Because M31/M37 configurations are immutable until drain/release, the M38 one-context equation must be summed over streams: 5*N+5*S with S=45. M243 omits 44 fills, or 220 cycles. The corrected candidate is 36,591,975 cycles, module ratio 1.999987702x, and fixed-compute diagnostic 1.062627046x. The numerical impact is tiny, but exact finite-population admission is fail-closed and therefore NOGO until a correction overlay is sealed. The hardware direction remains GO. M37's 63,114.407654 um2 is a standalone stage2 sidecar, not the complete decoupled candidate or a matched incremental area.

findings.title: One global startup is applied to a 45-context population
findings.evidence: The hash-bound raw execution trace has 450 T10 records: 45 distinct T10 operators in each of 10 samples. Each sample independently sums to N=7,318,350 tiles. M38's 5+5N recurrence begins after switch_context for one immutable context; M31/M37 require drain/release before changing parameters. Summing one frame therefore gives 5N+5*45=36,591,975 cycles, not 5N+5=36,591,755.
findings.impact: M243 undercounts 220 cycles and overstates the exact module ratio as 1.999999727x instead of 1.999987702x. Magnitude is negligible, but the claimed exact finite-population result is false.
findings.required_fix: Publish a fail-closed correction overlay with stream count S=45, per-stream tile counts, sum_i(5+5*N_i), corrected fixed-compute diagnostic 1.062627046x, and revocation of the old exact values.

findings.title: M31 and M37 are not the same executable functional boundary
findings.evidence: M31 consumes a five-beat raw T10 tile and performs stage1 requantization plus serialized stage2. M37 begins at a 384-bit vector of 48 already-quantized intermediates and implements only CSD stage2. M38 joins these only in an abstract Python state model; integrated RTL and integrated VCS are explicitly false.
findings.required_fix: Build or trace-drive a finite stage1-to-M37 adapter with exact tags, context barriers, intermediate quantization and shared FIFO credits before promoting the result beyond conditional kernel modeling.

findings.title: 63,114 um2 is sidecar area, not complete candidate area
findings.evidence: The synthesized M37 top has CSD reconstruction, two private 384-bit intermediate banks and a private 16-entry result FIFO, but no rank3 stage1 or shared96 multiplier pool. Thus it is neither total candidate area nor a normalized incremental sidecar area for M38's one-slot/shared-FIFO target.
findings.required_fix: Rename the JSON field to standalone_sidecar_logic_only_area and synthesize matched serial and decoupled tops with identical raw ports, context state, buffers/FIFO and constraints.

findings.title: Current Synopsys evidence is asymmetric
findings.evidence: M31 current r4 admission is VCS-only with DC/STA/Formality false. M37 r13 has standalone DC/STA/Formality. M38 has no RTL/DC/STA/Formality. A same-boundary throughput-per-area point cannot be formed.
findings.required_fix: Run exact-SHA matched serial and decoupled top DC/STA/Formality; retain throughput-per-area=false until then.

findings.title: The near-2x schedule is resident-context and no-stall only
findings.evidence: M38 explicitly excludes configuration-load cycles and result backpressure from the formula. M31 II10 is conditional on available banks, FIFO credits and unchanged context. The eventual-sink tests prove bounded directed drains, not the frozen workload's sustained II5.
findings.required_fix: Report the assumptions on every cycle row and run the ordered trace through finite buffers, result stalls and all 45 context barriers.

findings.title: The factorized rank3 network is not accuracy-admitted
findings.evidence: M26 reports zero T10 checkpoint matrices numerically rank<=3; PAFT/trained rank3 accuracy and end-to-end bitplane semantics remain false. N is an opportunity population for a hypothetical trained factorized model.
findings.required_fix: Keep trained_accuracy=false and bind any future performance result to the admitted PAFT checkpoint and exact coefficient/context census.

findings.title: The 1.062627x value is fixed-compute Amdahl context only
findings.evidence: It substitutes T10 compute cycles inside 620,868,243 fixed compute cycles. Memory, configuration traffic, integrated stalls and full-system scheduling are absent. M243 correctly sets system_speedup=false.
findings.required_fix: Use the corrected 1.062627046x only as a conditional fixed-compute diagnostic and never as system speedup.

findings.title: The admitted M37 source is a historical r10 snapshot
findings.evidence: The r13 Synopsys source is rtl_m37_r10 SHA f9474151..., while live rtl_m37 is SHA a5f42567.... M243 pins the review summary but does not name the snapshot path in its architecture payload.
findings.required_fix: Every integration contract must pin rtl_m37_r10/f947 explicitly; do not silently synthesize the live rtl_m37 source.

findings.title: M37 timing and area are ideal standalone screens
findings.evidence: The 3 ns run uses ZeroWireload, ideal unpropagated clock, no I/O delays and zero macros/black boxes. Setup/hold pass and Formality are valid only within this scope.
findings.required_fix: Do not call it paper PPA or physical frequency; preserve all qualifiers.

findings.title: M243 directly rehashes summaries, not the full raw transitive chain
findings.evidence: The analyzer validates four summary JSONs and docs359. The raw trace and M30/M26/profile chain are present only through nested hashes and were independently rechecked here.
findings.required_fix: The correction overlay should pin the raw execution_trace and its manifest directly because stream count S is now a first-class input.

findings.title: M31 phase fault recovery remains excluded
findings.evidence: M31 r4 admits static legal phases but records phase_5_through_7_fault_behavior_admitted=false.
findings.required_fix: Retain legal-mode assumptions or close the fault behavior in the integrated top.

allowed_claims: All M243 declared SHA identities and its own result manifest pass; a wrong upstream SHA is rejected fail-closed.
The raw trace independently yields 45 T10 operator contexts and N=7,318,350 tiles per inference.
For one uninterrupted context, the M38 conditional no-stall recurrence is exactly 10N/(5+5N).
For the frozen one-frame 45-context population, the corrected conditional compute-only cycles are 36,591,975 and the ratio is 1.999987702x.
The corrected fixed-compute-only Amdahl diagnostic is 1.062627046x and is not system speedup.
Standalone M37 r10/f947 logic-only DC/STA/Formality reports 63,114.407654 um2, setup/hold met, zero mapped multipliers and 5,276 passing compare points; this is sidecar-only.
forbidden_claims: M243's 36,591,755 cycles and 1.999999727x are exact for the aggregated frozen population
The 63,114.407654 um2 M37 result is the complete decoupled ATLIF candidate area
M31 and M37 have a matched full-module Synopsys comparison
The corrected near-2x value is integrated RTL throughput, throughput-per-area, trained-model speedup or system speedup
The 1.062627x fixed-compute diagnostic is full-system speedup
Any current result is paper PPA, energy or headline-ready
